pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual patches exhibit rounded, lobed geometries with soft, diffused pixel gradients at the edges rather than sharp angularity. Spatial area is variable, with larger, more elongated patches on the upper neck transitioning to smaller, more irregular sub-circular shapes on the flank and haunch.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light pelage corridors form a continuous, interconnected topological graph. Intersection nodes are characterized by wide, rounded junctions. Corridor pixel thickness is relatively high and uniform across the midsection, maintaining consistent continuity with minimal narrowing.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The 1D contour of the mane shows low-amplitude, high-frequency serration against the background. The silhouette presents as a dark, textured fringe along the dorsal line of the neck, though softened by motion or resolution limits.
